title: Add Flask app with exposed string endpoint
approach: Create a new file `app.py` that initializes a Flask web application. Define a string variable within this file and create a GET endpoint `/my-string` that returns the value of this string. Update `requirements.txt` to include the Flask dependency.
tests_to_write: Verify that a GET request to `/my-string` on the running Flask app returns the expected string.
edge_cases: Ensure the Flask application starts correctly on the specified port.
Handle potential network issues or server unavailability when making a request to the endpoint.
